properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 12 at 12:32PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Peachtree City GA has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Georgia...

Nickajack Creek at US 278 near Mableton affecting Cobb County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Nickajack Creek at US 278 near Mableton.

* WHEN...From this afternoon until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, Flood stage is reached. Minor flooding will
occur in the woodlands and the natural flood plain upstream and
downstream from the gage at Veterans Memorial Highway. Portions of
Nickajack Park will begin to flood around one mile upstream from
the gage.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 12:00 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 10.2 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 12:00 PM EDT Saturday was 10.2 feet.
- Forecast...No forecast is available for this location.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 10.2
feet on 12/30/2021.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at weather.gov/atlanta.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 1:28PM CDT until September 12 at 2:30PM CDT by NWS Jackson MS
properties.description:
SVRJAN

The National Weather Service in Jackson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Carroll County in north central Mississippi...
Grenada County in north central Mississippi...
Northwestern Montgomery County in north central Mississippi...

* Until 230 PM CDT.

* At 128 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Velma to near Grenada to near Leflore, moving
southeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Severe thunderstorms will be near...
Grenada, Bew Springs, and Leflore around 135 PM CDT.
Jefferson around 145 PM CDT.
Elliott and Gore Springs around 150 PM CDT.
Duck Hill and Misterton around 200 PM CDT.
Sweatman around 210 PM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 12 at 2:32PM EDT until September 12 at 5:30PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
FFWRLX

The National Weather Service in Charleston has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Braxton County in north central West Virginia...

* Until 530 PM EDT.

* At 232 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen over the last hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Falls Mills.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Report flooding to the National Weather Service by calling toll free,
800 401 9535, when you can do so safely.

properties.areaDesc: Terrebonne Bay; Coastal Waters from Port Fourchon LA to Lower Atchafalaya River LA out 20 nm
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 12 at 1:42PM CDT until September 12 at 2:15PM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Terrebonne Bay...
Coastal Waters from Port Fourchon LA to Lower Atchafalaya River LA
out 20 nm...

At 142 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing waterspouts
were located along a line from 5 NM northeast of Timbalier Bay to
near Isle Derniers, moving southeast at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Timbalier Island and Isle Derniers.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
